The schema is a plain `configSchema` object that the module passes to `defineConfigSchema(moduleName, schema)` from its `startupApp()`. The schema tree uses `_type`, `_default`, `_description`, `_validators` and `_elements` keys. Implementers then override values by module name, but I did not read the code that applies those overrides, so that part is unverified.

**Documentation**
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-framework/docs/functions/defineConfigSchema.md` documents the function. It points to the external Configuration System guide at o3-docs.openmrs.org/en-US/docs/configuration-system, which is not in these repositories.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-framework/docs/functions/defineExtensionConfigSchema.md` is the same for per-extension schemas.

**Implementation**
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/src/module-config/module-config.ts` lines 369–378 are `defineConfigSchema`. It validates the schema, merges it with the implicit schema, and stores it under the module name. Line 445 starts `defineExtensionConfigSchema`; I did not read its body.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/src/types.ts` lines 17–22 define the `ConfigSchema` interface.

**Examples**
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/config-schema.ts` lines 7–22 show a nested schema with `Type`, `_default`, `_description` and `_validators`.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/index.ts` lines 19–21 call `defineConfigSchema` inside `startupApp`.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-api/src/config-schema.ts` lines 5–27 show arrays with `_elements`.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-api/src/setup.ts` line 9 registers the framework's own schema.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-allergies-app/src/config-schema.ts` lines 16–40 show a `ConceptUuid` schema with defaults.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-allergies-app/src/index.ts` lines 18–20 call `defineConfigSchema` in `startupApp`.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-flags-app/src/index.ts` lines 11–13 also register extension schemas.
